papers.title: TID System for Speech-COSER Challenge 2026: ASR Track
papers.translated_title: 语音-COSER挑战赛2026的TID系统：ASR赛道
papers.author: Fernando López
papers.summary: We describe the system submitted by Telefónica Innovación Digital to the Speech-COSER Challenge 2026, which features spontaneous speech from elderly speakers recorded in rural Spain. For ASR, we perform CTC-based pseudo-forced alignment scores audio-text match quality to guide a two-stage LoRA curriculum, followed by post-hoc magnitude pruning of the LoRA matrices to enhance generalization. An ensemble of seven systems combined via ROVER achieves 36.25\% unnormalized and 22.17\% normalized WER.
papers.translated_summary: 我们描述了Telefónica Innovación Digital提交至Speech-COSER Challenge 2026的系统，该挑战赛以西班牙农村地区录制的老年说话人自发语音为特征。对于ASR，我们执行基于CTC的伪强制对齐，对音频-文本匹配质量进行评分，以指导两阶段LoRA课程，随后对LoRA矩阵进行事后幅度剪枝以增强泛化能力。通过ROVER组合的七个系统集成实现了36.25%的未归一化和22.17%的归一化WER。

papers.title: Regret without Optimal-Arm Feedback under Reward-Dependent Delays
papers.translated_title: 无最优臂反馈下的遗憾在奖励依赖延迟中
papers.author: Zhong Han
papers.summary: We study stochastic bandits with reward-dependent delays, possibly infinite, whose reports omit the originating round. For each $c\in[0,1)$, Balanced Historical Optimism (BHO) has a delay term controlled by the largest suboptimal-arm quantile at level $1-cΔ_i$, without requiring optimal-arm reports. Lower bounds give an inverse-square slack cost in the logarithmic statistical regime and linear minimax regret at $c=1$. A family with growing $K$ forces worst-case regret $Ω(G\log K)$ for every learner, where $G=\max_iΔ_i h_i$ is the largest gap-weighted suboptimal cutoff. Pending-triggered balance preserves BHO's weighted-cutoff bound for $c<1$ and attains the historical-greedy exploration coefficient with deterministic rewards, a unique optimum and fixed bounded delays. Gap-weighted comparisons and experiments show when shared waiting helps and what balanced exploration costs.
papers.translated_summary: 我们研究具有奖励依赖延迟（可能是无限延迟）的随机赌博机，其报告省略了原始轮次。对于每个 $c\in[0,1)$，平衡历史乐观（BHO）具有一个由水平 $1-cΔ_i$ 处最大次优臂分位数控制的延迟项，且不需要最优臂的报告。下界在对数统计区域给出了平方反比松弛代价，并在 $c=1$ 时给出了线性极小极大遗憾。一个 $K$ 增长的族对每个学习器都强制最坏情况遗憾 $Ω(G\log K)$，其中 $G=\max_iΔ_i h_i$ 是最大的间隙加权次优截断。待触发平衡在 $c<1$ 时保持了 BHO 的加权截断界，并在确定性奖励、唯一最优和固定有界延迟下达到了历史贪婪探索系数。间隙加权比较和实验展示了共享等待何时有帮助以及平衡探索的代价。

papers.title: Learning through Capacity Awareness to Minimize Hospital Readmissions
papers.translated_title: 通过容量意识学习以最小化医院再入院
papers.author: Lydia T. Liu
papers.summary: Predictive algorithms are increasingly used to guide hospital discharge decisions, yet these models can exhibit censoring bias for vulnerable patients due to insufficient historical data or past discharge decisions. When biased readmission risk predictors are used to inform discharges, the training data generated by discharge decisions may perpetuate similar biases when predictors are re-trained, leading to a vicious cycle. We extend a queueing-based Markov decision process for hospital discharge to incorporate periodically retrained readmission risk predictors. Our key insight is that cost-optimal, "capacity-aware" operational decision policies can naturally diversify the lengths of stay at which patient outcomes are observed, enabling consistent estimation of readmission risk without explicit fairness constraints. We prove that repeated retraining under discharge-up-to policies converges to unbiased risk estimates under well-specification. In synthetic experiments and calibrated simulations based on patient-level data from a partner hospital, we find that where commonly used threshold-on-risk policies can remain persistently biased, discharge-up-to policies reduce learning error over status quo decision policies (such as thresholding on risk) by 24%-25%. These improvements to estimation also mitigate some forms of bias, reducing readmission cost disparities (adjusted for baseline risk differences between demographic groups) by 38%-63%. Our results demonstrate how capacity-aware decision policies can improve both predictive performance and fairness by addressing censoring bias.
papers.translated_summary: 预测算法越来越多地被用于指导医院出院决策，然而这些模型可能因历史数据不足或过往出院决策而对脆弱患者表现出删失偏差。当有偏的再入院风险预测器被用于指导出院时，由出院决策生成的训练数据在预测器重新训练时可能延续类似的偏差，从而导致恶性循环。我们将基于排队的马尔可夫决策过程扩展用于医院出院，以纳入定期重新训练的再入院风险预测器。我们的关键洞见是，成本最优的“容量感知”运营决策策略能够自然地使观察患者结果所处的住院时长多样化，从而在没有显式公平约束的情况下实现再入院风险的一致估计。我们证明，在良好设定下，出院至多策略下的反复重新训练会收敛到无偏的风险估计。在合成实验和基于合作医院患者级数据校准的模拟中，我们发现，常用的风险阈值策略可能持续存在偏差，而出院至多策略相比现状决策策略（如对风险进行阈值化）将学习误差降低了24%-25%。这些估计上的改进还缓解了某些形式的偏差，将再入院成本差异（经调整人口群体间基线风险差异后）降低了38%-63%。我们的结果表明，容量感知决策策略如何通过解决删失偏差来同时改善预测性能和公平性。

papers.title: CallCleaner: Lightweight Bioacoustic Denoising from an Audio Foundation Model
papers.translated_title: CallCleaner：基于音频基础模型的轻量级生物声学去噪
papers.author: Michael Xie
papers.summary: Many studies of animal vocalizations require clean recordings, but animals are usually recorded in the field, with background noise from weather, vehicles, and other animals. Animal vocalization denoising is challenged by the scarcity of clean training data and the extreme diversity of animal vocalizations. Classical spectral gates leave residual noise, especially without voice activity detection (VAD), while detector-free neural denoisers designed for bioacoustics remove less noise. We show that a general-purpose source separation foundation model, SAM-Audio, removes more noise than either of these types of methods, when used without training and prompted with time spans from a simple animal VAD. To turn this heavy method into a practical tool, we distill it into CallCleaner, a 19M-parameter denoiser that needs no detector and runs ~90x faster than real time on a laptop CPU. We find that SI-SDR has limited utility in our setting as it penalizes regenerated output and conflates noise removal with call fidelity, a trade-off our separate metrics reveal. CallCleaner leaves 11 dB less noise around the call than Biodenoising, the leading neural bioacoustic denoiser with public weights, and among fast, CPU-capable systems it pushes the Pareto frontier of noise removal vs. call fidelity, without requiring a detector. We release code and weights for CallCleaner, which enables fast, private, local denoising of single-caller recordings without specialized hardware.
papers.translated_summary: 许多动物发声研究需要干净的录音，但动物通常在野外被录制，伴有来自天气、车辆和其他动物的背景噪声。动物发声降噪面临干净训练数据稀缺和动物发声极端多样性的挑战。经典谱门会留下残余噪声，尤其是在没有语音活动检测（VAD）的情况下，而为生物声学设计的无检测器神经降噪器去除的噪声较少。我们表明，一种通用源分离基础模型 SAM-Audio，在未经训练并使用来自简单动物 VAD 的时间跨度作为提示时，比这两类方法去除更多噪声。为了将这种重型方法转变为实用工具，我们将其蒸馏为 CallCleaner，一个 19M 参数的降噪器，无需检测器，在笔记本电脑 CPU 上运行速度约为实时的 90 倍。我们发现 SI-SDR 在我们的设置中效用有限，因为它惩罚再生输出并将噪声去除与叫声保真度混为一谈，而我们的单独指标揭示了这种权衡。CallCleaner 在叫声周围留下的噪声比 Biodenoising 少 11 dB，后者是具有公开权重的领先神经生物声学降噪器，并且在快速、CPU 可运行的系统当中，它在噪声去除与叫声保真度之间推动了帕累托前沿，且无需检测器。我们发布了 CallCleaner 的代码和权重，这使得无需专用硬件即可对单发声者录音进行快速、私密、本地的降噪。

papers.title: THEATRON: A Benchmark for Evaluating Persona Persistence in Long-Horizon LLM Decision-Making
papers.translated_title: THEATRON：评估长时程LLM决策中角色持续性的基准
papers.author: Yuyan Wang
papers.summary: Existing evaluations often test persona expression rather than whether persona information persists in extended decision-making. We introduce THEATRON, a controlled benchmark that uses financial replay to evaluate persona persistence in long-horizon sequential decision-making. In these environments, models conditioned on fixed behavioral-finance personas observe shared daily market evidence and trajectory-specific account-state feedback and make sequential decisions over multi-month trajectories. We evaluate Zero-Shot, One-Shot, and Chain-of-Thought persona injection across four LLMs, using cumulative-return and action trajectories to diagnose within-persona stability, cross-persona separability, and action collapse. Persona conditioning produces systematic behavioral shifts beyond a no-persona baseline, and persona-level separation generally exceeds the variation induced by semantically equivalent descriptions. Nevertheless, these shifts do not reliably form coherent persona-specific policies: apparently stable separation can arise from stereotyped action collapse, while diverse policies can exhibit noisy trajectory switching. These findings expose a gap between observable persona-induced behavior and persistent, context-sensitive persona-conditioned decision policies. Code and benchmark data are publicly available at: https://github.com/yuyan12138/theatron
papers.translated_summary: 现有评估往往测试人格表达，而非人格信息能否在扩展决策中持续存在。我们提出THEATRON，一个受控基准，利用金融回放评估长时程序贯决策中的人格持续性。在这些环境中，以固定行为金融人格为条件的模型观察共享的每日市场证据和轨迹特定的账户状态反馈，并在多个月轨迹上做出序贯决策。我们评估了四种LLM上的零样本、单样本和思维链人格注入，使用累计收益和动作轨迹来诊断人格内稳定性、跨人格可分性以及动作坍缩。人格条件化产生了超越无人格基线的系统性行为偏移，且人格层面的分离通常超过语义等价描述所引发的变异。然而，这些偏移并不能可靠地形成连贯的人格特定策略：看似稳定的分离可能源于刻板化的动作坍缩，而多样化的策略可能表现出嘈杂的轨迹切换。这些发现揭示了可观察的人格诱导行为与持续的、情境敏感的人格条件化决策策略之间的差距。代码和基准数据公开可用，地址为：https://github.com/yuyan12138/theatron

papers.title: MicroSim: Contrastive Graph Neural Networks for Binary Code Similarity Detection
papers.translated_title: MicroSim：用于二进制代码相似性检测的对比图神经网络
papers.author: Moussa Moussaoui
papers.summary: We present MicroSim, a system for binary code similarity detection that represents each function as a graph built from IDA Pro Hex-Rays microcode and compares such graphs with a contrastive Siamese graph neural network (GNN). We evaluate on the TREX cross-optimization benchmark, a corpus of 849,072 function-level microcode graphs spanning optimization levels -O0 through -O3, under a strict class-disjoint split in which no function key is shared between train and test. Under this protocol, MicroSim reaches 0.9972 area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) and 0.9762 Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), outperforming Gemini (0.9332 ROC-AUC), SAFE (0.9752), and jTrans (0.9740) retrained on the same split, as well as a structure-free Bag-of-Words (BoW) baseline (0.9484). We analyze the gap between pair classification and ranked retrieval in graph transformers, showing that Cross-domain Similarity Local Scaling (CSLS) under unified tie-resolved evaluation raises GraphGPS mean reciprocal rank (MRR) from 0.2542 to 0.2559 (R@1 = 0.1639, R@10 = 0.4561), strictly satisfying the theoretical MRR upper bound. Finally, over 5 seeds with equal compute, the pairwise cosine-embedding loss attains a slightly higher ROC-AUC (Δ = -0.0256, 95% confidence interval [-0.3282, +0.2770]), whereas the supervised-contrastive information noise-contrastive estimation (InfoNCE) loss is significantly better on thresholded classification and ranked retrieval.
papers.translated_summary: 我们提出MicroSim，一种二进制代码相似性检测系统，它将每个函数表示为基于IDA Pro Hex-Rays微码构建的图，并使用对比式孪生图神经网络（GNN）比较此类图。我们在TREX跨优化基准上进行评估，该语料库包含849,072个函数级微码图，覆盖-O0至-O3优化级别，并采用严格的类不相交划分，即训练集与测试集之间不共享任何函数键。在该协议下，MicroSim达到0.9972的接收者操作特征曲线下面积（ROC-AUC）和0.9762的马修斯相关系数（MCC），优于在同一划分上重新训练的Gemini（0.9332 ROC-AUC）、SAFE（0.9752）和jTrans（0.9740），以及无结构的词袋（BoW）基线（0.9484）。我们分析了图Transformer中成对分类与排序检索之间的差距，表明在统一平局消解评估下的跨域相似性局部缩放（CSLS）将GraphGPS的平均倒数排名（MRR）从0.2542提升至0.2559（R@1 = 0.1639，R@10 = 0.4561），严格满足理论MRR上界。最后，在相同计算量下进行5个随机种子实验，成对余弦嵌入损失获得略高的ROC-AUC（Δ = -0.0256，95%置信区间[-0.3282, +0.2770]），而监督对比信息噪声对比估计（InfoNCE）损失在阈值分类和排序检索上显著更优。

papers.title: Causal Machine Learning for Multilevel Studies with Unmeasured Cluster-Level Covariates via Variational Autoencoders
papers.translated_title: 通过变分自编码器处理未测量聚类层面协变量的多层次研究因果机器学习
papers.author: Youmi Suk
papers.summary: Unmeasured confounders are a key obstacle to accurately estimating treatment effects in observational studies, and in multilevel data, they often arise at the cluster level. Flexible machine learning methods cannot directly resolve such unmeasured confounding. To address this, we propose the variational autoencoder-augmented R-learner (VAE-R), which leverages variational autoencoders (VAEs) to infer unmeasured cluster-level covariates from the within-cluster dependence of outcome and treatment residuals, and uses the resulting adjustments to estimate the conditional average treatment effect (CATE) and the average treatment effect (ATE). The VAE decoder is specified through an offset likelihood so that the latent variables capture only the cluster-level variation left unexplained by measured covariates. VAE-R accommodates unmeasured cluster-level confounders in observational studies and unmeasured cluster-level predictors of the outcome in multisite randomized trials. We also provide data-driven strategies for selecting the two hyperparameters of the VAE, the latent dimension size and the Kullback-Leibler weight. Our simulation study shows that VAE-R nearly eliminates the bias of the ordinary R-learner's CATE and ATE estimates in multilevel observational data and improves their precision in multisite randomized trials. Finally, we illustrate VAE-R with two datasets, one from a multilevel observational study and the other from a multisite randomized trial.
papers.translated_summary: 未测量的混杂因素是观察性研究中准确估计处理效应的关键障碍，而在多层次数据中，它们往往出现在聚类层面。灵活的机器学习方法无法直接解决此类未测量的混杂问题。为此，我们提出了变分自编码器增强R-learner（VAE-R），该方法利用变分自编码器（VAE）从结局和处理残差的簇内依赖性中推断未测量的聚类层面协变量，并利用所得的调整来估计条件平均处理效应（CATE）和平均处理效应（ATE）。VAE解码器通过偏移似然来指定，使得潜在变量仅捕获由已测量协变量未能解释的聚类层面变异。VAE-R适用于观察性研究中未测量的聚类层面混杂因素以及多站点随机试验中未测量的聚类层面结局预测因子。我们还提供了数据驱动的策略来选择VAE的两个超参数，即潜在维度大小和Kullback-Leibler权重。我们的模拟研究表明，VAE-R在多层次观察性数据中几乎消除了普通R-learner的CATE和ATE估计的偏差，并在多站点随机试验中提高了其精度。最后，我们用两个数据集来说明VAE-R，一个来自多层次观察性研究，另一个来自多站点随机试验。

papers.title: One-Shot Hierarchical Federated Clustering for Distributed Non-IID Biomedical Data Analysis
papers.translated_title: 面向分布式非独立同分布生物医学数据分析的一次性分层联邦聚类
papers.author: Shenghong Cai
papers.summary: In multi-institutional biomedical data analysis, comprehensive disease profiles are often fragmented across different data silos. Furthermore, local data distributions typically exhibit varying levels of granularity or even complex nested structures. Although Hierarchical Clustering (HC) is a powerful tool for exploring such data topologies, its cumbersome recursive process incurs prohibitive computational overhead and renders it highly susceptible to privacy leakage. This paper, therefore, introduces an efficient one-shot hierarchical FC framework that performs client-end (institutions) distribution exploration and server-end distribution aggregation through one-way prototype-level communication from clients to the server. Although the designed one-shot prototype transmission guarantees minimal computational overhead and mitigates privacy risks, it inevitably incurs information loss. To counteract this, a multi-granular competitive learning mechanism is proposed on the server to fuse the clusterlets, effectively maximizing the retention and mining of global distribution topologies under limited, one-way communication constraints. It turns out that the complex cluster distributions across clients can be efficiently explored, and extensive experiments comparing state-of-the-art methods on public datasets demonstrate the superiority of the proposed framework in balancing robust clustering, privacy preservation, and computational efficiency.
papers.translated_summary: 在多机构生物医学数据分析中，全面的疾病画像往往分散在不同的数据孤岛中。此外，本地数据分布通常呈现不同层次的粒度，甚至具有复杂的嵌套结构。尽管层次聚类（HC）是探索此类数据拓扑的有力工具，但其繁琐的递归过程带来高昂的计算开销，并使其极易发生隐私泄露。因此，本文提出一种高效的一次性层次联邦聚类框架，通过从客户端到服务器的单向原型级通信，在客户端（机构）进行分布探索，在服务器端进行分布聚合。尽管所设计的一次性原型传输保证了最小的计算开销并降低了隐私风险，但它不可避免地带来信息损失。为应对这一问题，在服务器端提出一种多粒度竞争学习机制以融合聚类子簇，从而在有限的单向通信约束下有效最大化全局分布拓扑的保留与挖掘。结果表明，跨客户端的复杂聚类分布可以被高效探索，在公开数据集上与最先进方法进行的大量对比实验证明了所提框架在平衡稳健聚类、隐私保护和计算效率方面的优越性。

papers.title: Beyond Ranking: Are Decision Models Calibrated Relevance Scorers?
papers.translated_title: 超越排名：决策模型是校准的相关性评分器吗？
papers.author: Shengyao Zhuang
papers.summary: Decision models such as Jev are a new kind of relevance scorer. Their typed score primitive takes a question, an ordered set of textual relevance levels and a state, and returns a probability for each level directly, rather than token likelihoods or generated labels. Jev's vendor promises that these probabilities are calibrated. This motivates revisiting 'Beyond Yes and No', which improved zero-shot pointwise LLM reranking using likelihood-derived scores over fine-grained relevance labels but left calibration against human assessors as future work. In this paper, we first reproduce its open-model FLAN-UL2 setting on eight BEIR collections, confirming its ranking trends, and then run Jev and two open-weight decision models with the same protocol. Jev and the 27B pplx-decider rerank ahead of FLAN-UL2 and three cross-encoders on average. We then compare Jev's native probabilities with the human assessors' labels and find them overconfident: of the DL21 pairs it scores above 0.9, only 66% are relevant. Since this is mostly an error of scale, a two-parameter calibration fitted on 2,257 DL19 pairs removes much of it and transfers to DL21. After calibration, Jev has a lower DL21 Brier score than FLAN-UL2 and the three cross-encoders, mainly because it separates relevant from non-relevant pairs better. Finally, with calibrated probabilities, choosing each query's cut-off by expected F1 needs no parameter of its own, beats a fixed top-10 cut and matches a cut-off threshold tuned on DL19.
papers.translated_summary: Jev 等决策模型是一类新型相关性评分器。其类型化评分原语接收一个问题、一组有序的文本相关性等级和一个状态，直接返回每个等级的概率，而非 token 似然或生成的标签。Jev 的供应商承诺这些概率是经过校准的。这促使我们重新审视“Beyond Yes and No”，该工作利用从似然导出的分数在细粒度相关性标签上改进了零样本逐点 LLM 重排序，但将针对人工评估者的校准留作未来工作。在本文中，我们首先在八个 BEIR 集合上复现其开放模型 FLAN-UL2 设置，确认其排序趋势，然后以相同协议运行 Jev 和两个开放权重决策模型。Jev 和 27B pplx-decider 平均而言重排序效果优于 FLAN-UL2 和三个交叉编码器。随后我们将 Jev 的原生概率与人工评估者的标签进行比较，发现其过度自信：在其评分高于 0.9 的 DL21 对上，仅 66% 是相关的。由于这主要是尺度误差，在 2,257 个 DL19 对上拟合的两参数校准消除了大部分误差，并可迁移至 DL21。校准后，Jev 的 DL21 Brier 分数低于 FLAN-UL2 和三个交叉编码器，主要因为它更好地区分相关对与非相关对。最后，借助校准后的概率，通过期望 F1 为每个查询选择截断值无需自身参数，优于固定的 top-10 截断，并与在 DL19 上调优的截断阈值相当。

papers.title: Robust and Private Swarm Learning via Zero-Knowledge Validator Admission and Consensus Aggregation
papers.translated_title: 基于零知识验证器准入与共识聚合的鲁棒隐私群体学习
papers.author: Marco Arazzi
papers.summary: Swarm Learning improves resilience and removes the need for a single trusted coordinator by distributing model aggregation and validation across participating nodes. However, it also delegates the validation of model updates to peers whose private data may be biased, unrepresentative, or adversarial, and existing Swarm Learning protocols generally do not attest that data, leaving decentralized validation as an attack surface. We present a robust, privacy-preserving Swarm Learning framework that makes verifiable data quality the condition for admission to the learning task. A validator joins only after a zero-knowledge attestation proves, without revealing any raw sample, that a reference model ran correctly on its private data. The attested outputs also yield a label-free class profile, so the network assembles a collectively IID validator pool from individually skewed validators as accurately as an oracle with the true labels (total-variation distance to uniform 0.025, against 0.021 for the oracle and 0.21 for random selection). Admitted validators score client updates and, through a Tendermint-style Byzantine Fault Tolerant consensus, agree on a gradient mask and a quality-derived aggregation weight for each submission, replacing dataset-size weighting with a quality-aware signal. Adapting the cut-layer idea of Split Learning, a challenge-based audit lets peers re-verify that a mask was computed on the attested data without an expensive end-to-end zero-knowledge proof. Across four benchmarks under non-IID partitions the framework matches FedAvg on clean data; under a gradient-scaling attack that collapses FedAvg to random chance, it retains 94% of clean accuracy on CIFAR-100 and over 99% on FashionMNIST, where FedAvg achieves only 2.1% and 11%. The result is a private, robust, and auditable foundation for decentralized learning.

papers.title: Effects of Overripe Banana Processing Techniques on the Chemical Composition and Attractancy to Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus
papers.translated_title: 过熟香蕉加工技术对化学成分及对埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊引诱性的影响
papers.author: Abuelmaali, S. A.
papers.summary: The rising incidence of vector-borne diseases transmitted by mosquitoes has become a significant public health concern. The increasing resistance of mosquitoes to conventional insecticides has prompted the need for alternative control strategies such as Attractive Targeted Sugar Baits (ATSBs). While fruit-based attractants have shown promise, the impact of different production methods on their attractiveness remains underexplored. This study investigates the effect of three production techniques of overripe banana (Musa acuminata) extracts: liquid extraction, syrup concentration, and freeze-drying, on the chemical composition and their attractiveness to Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus. Extracts were infused into hydrogel beads and tested in dual-choice olfactometer assays to mosquito vectors Ae. aegypti and Ae. albopictus. Chemical profiling was conducted through Gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) and enzymatic sugar analysis. Results showed that all banana extracts were significantly more attractive than the 10% sucrose control. Among the extracts, syrup concentrates showed the highest attraction (PI = 0.58 {+/-} 0.17 for Ae. aegypti; 0.58 {+/-} 0.14 for Ae. albopictus), followed by freeze-dried (PI = 0.52 {+/-} 0.20; 0.54 {+/-} 0.08) and liquid extracts (PI = -0.40 {+/-} 0.04; 0.49 {+/-} 0.18). GC-MS analysis revealed that freeze-dried powder retained the greatest diversity and abundance of volatile organic compounds (VOCs), especially esters like butyl ethanoate and isoamyl acetate, which are known to influence mosquito behaviour. Although syrup concentration resulted in VOCs degradation, it also generated Maillard reaction products, such as sulphur-containing volatiles, which may enhance olfactory cues. Sugar analysis indicated that both syrup and freeze-dried extracts contained higher levels of sucrose (0.35-0.57 g/100g), glucose (21.20-28.70 g/100g), fructose (14.64-17.89 g/100g), and maltose (9.28-15.56 g/100g), aligning with mosquito preferences. Overall, the findings demonstrate that production techniques significantly influence the chemical composition and attractant potential of overripe banana extracts, offering valuable insights for the development of fruit-based mosquito lures in vector surveillance and control strategies.

papers.title: Engineered microvessel networks -- Longitudinal transcriptomic profiling validates chip-grown tissues as a robust model for studying vasculature
papers.translated_title: 工程化微血管网络——纵向转录组分析验证芯片培养组织作为研究血管系统的可靠模型
papers.author: Osorio, L. A.
papers.summary: Vascularised Organ-on-Chip (OoC) models are promising New Approach Methodologies (NAMs), but their translation requires validation for defined Contexts of Use (CoU). Here, we combine microfluidic microvessel networks (MVNs) with longitudinal bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing to determine how cell provenance influences engineered vascular phenotype. Stromal cell identity produced distinct network architectures and transcriptional trajectories, demonstrating that support cells, commonly treated as interchangeable, represent an important CoU variable. Primary human pancreatic microvascular endothelial cells failed to form stable perfusable networks, but supplementation with 10% Human Umbilical Vein Endothelial Cells (HUVECs) or Blood Outgrowth Endothelial Cells (BOECs) rescued self-assembly. Single-cell transcriptomics identified specialised endothelial populations associated with vascular morphogenesis, including tip, stalk, phalanx, endothelial to mesenchymal transition (EndMT) and pericyte-like endothelial cells. Failed networks lacked coherent endothelial specialisation, whereas rescued networks restored stabilising cell states and revealed FLRT2--UNC5B signalling within pericyte-like HUVECs, recapitulating a pathway implicated in angiogenic development in vivo. These findings establish cell provenance as a critical determinant of microvascular NAM performance and demonstrate how transcriptomic validation can define and strengthen the biological relevance of microvessel-on-chip models for specific CoUs.

papers.title: PROST: An Open Toolbox, Harmonised Multi-Lab Dataset, and Meta-Analysis of Ankle-Foot Roll-Over Shape
papers.translated_title: PROST：一个开放工具箱、协调的多实验室数据集以及踝足滚动形状的元分析
papers.author: Reichsbouscher, C.
papers.summary: The ankle-foot roll-over shape (ROS) is the sagittal-plane path of the centre of pressure (CoP) during the stance phase of walking, expressed in a shank-based coordinate system. It describes the effective rocker geometry that emerges from both the shape and the elastic deformation of the ankle-foot system during walking, and informs prosthetic and orthotic design. Previous studies characterised ROS in small samples with differing laboratory protocols, so they have not systematically assessed inter-individual variability or its relation to anthropometrics. We developed the open-source Public ROS Toolbox (PROST) for standardised ROS computation, and used it to harmonise marker trajectories, ground reaction forces and CoP data from four public gait datasets collected in independent laboratories. For each leg, we fitted a circular arc to the pooled ROS of all its stance phases. In a one-stage individual-participant data meta-analysis, linear mixed-effects models, with dataset as a fixed effect and participant as a random intercept, related the arc radius and the horizontal coordinate of the circle centre to anthropometrics, and, in the two self-selected-speed datasets, to walking speed. The harmonised dataset comprises 249 participants and 5,667 stance phases at walking speeds of 0.7-8.5 km/h. Circular arcs fitted the ROS closely (mean RMS radial residual 1.9 mm). The radius had a median of 410.3 mm (interquartile range, IQR, 237.6 mm), and the circle centre lay posterior to the ankle (median -20.6 mm, IQR 49.5 mm). Between-participant differences, quantified by the intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC), accounted for 42% of the variance in log radius (95% CI 25-57%) and 47% of the variance in the horizontal coordinate of the circle centre (95% CI 24-65%). Anthropometrics explained a negligible share of this variance (radius: pseudo-R2 -0.001, 95% CI -0.03 to 0.12), and height normalisation did not reduce radius variability (robust coefficient of variation 43% with and without normalisation). Faster self-selected walking was associated with a larger radius and a more posterior circle centre. To our knowledge, this study provides the first harmonised multi-lab ROS dataset. Together with the open-source toolbox, it is publicly available to support reproducible research in gait biomechanics, rehabilitation device design and clinical gait assessment. ROS geometry was participant-specific but was not predicted by age, sex, height or mass. A device ROS scaled from anthropometrics is therefore unlikely to match an individual's ROS, motivating studies of whether matching it, through device geometry and stiffness, improves gait mechanics.
papers.translated_summary: 踝足滚动形状（ROS）是步行支撑相中压力中心（CoP）在矢状面内的轨迹，以基于小腿的坐标系表示。它描述了步行过程中由踝足系统的形状和弹性变形共同产生的有效摇椅几何形态，并为假肢和矫形器设计提供依据。以往研究以不同实验室方案在小样本中表征ROS，因此未能系统评估个体间变异性及其与人体测量学的关系。我们开发了开源公共ROS工具箱（PROST）用于标准化ROS计算，并利用它协调了来自四个独立实验室采集的公共步态数据集的标记点轨迹、地面反作用力和CoP数据。对每条腿，我们将所有支撑相的合并ROS拟合为圆弧。在一项单阶段个体参与者数据荟萃分析中，采用线性混合效应模型，以数据集为固定效应、参与者为随机截距，将圆弧半径和圆心水平坐标与人体测量学指标关联，并在两个自选速度数据集中与步行速度关联。协调后的数据集包含249名参与者和5,667个支撑相，步行速度为0.7-8.5 km/h。圆弧与ROS拟合紧密（平均RMS径向残差1.9 mm）。半径中位数为410.3 mm（四分位距IQR为237.6 mm），圆心位于踝关节后方（中位数-20.6 mm，IQR为49.5 mm）。参与者间差异（以组内相关系数ICC量化）占对数半径方差的42%（95% CI 25-57%）和圆心水平坐标方差的47%（95% CI 24-65%）。人体测量学指标解释的方差份额可忽略不计（半径：伪R2为-0.001，95% CI -0.03至0.12），身高归一化未降低半径变异性（归一化前后稳健变异系数均为43%）。较快的自选步行速度与较大的半径和更靠后的圆心相关。据我们所知，本研究提供了首个协调的多实验室ROS数据集。该数据集与开源工具箱一同公开可用，以支持步态生物力学、康复设备设计和临床步态评估中的可重复研究。ROS几何形态具有参与者特异性，但无法由年龄、性别、身高或体重预测。因此，依据人体测量学缩放得到的设备ROS不太可能匹配个体的ROS，这促使进一步研究通过设备几何形态和刚度来匹配个体ROS是否能改善步态力学。

papers.title: MorphoANOVA: Dissecting Histology-Gene Expression Relationships in Spatial Transcriptomics
papers.translated_title: MorphoANOVA：解析空间转录组学中的组织学-基因表达关系
papers.author: Chen, P.-W.
papers.summary: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) measures the expression of hundreds to thousands of genes within tissue architecture, often accompanied by histology images. However, it remains challenging to systematically characterize which genes exhibit associations with tissue morphology, whether these associations vary spatially, and which genes show additional spatial expression patterns beyond those captured by morphology. Here we introduce MorphoANOVA, a gene-wise statistical framework for characterizing morphology--expression relationships across genes measured by ST. Using nested spatially varying coefficient models and sequential ANOVA, MorphoANOVA assesses slide-wide associations with an H\&E-derived morphology feature, location-specific changes in these associations, and additional spatial variation after accounting for the selected feature. The resulting statistics enable gene prioritization and pathway enrichment analysis, while spatial component maps support the interpretation of individual genes. Simulations demonstrate MorphoANOVA's ability to distinguish the modeled components and recover their spatial patterns. Applications to human cortex and breast cancer identify biological programs associated with different morphology--expression patterns and reveal distinct relationships with cell composition. Across three HER2-positive breast cancer patients, invasive-cancer marker genes consistently exhibit stronger evidence of location-specific morphology associations. MorphoANOVA thus provides a framework for systematically interpreting spatial gene-expression patterns in relation to tissue morphology.
papers.translated_summary: 空间转录组学（ST）测量组织架构内数百至数千个基因的表达，通常伴随组织学图像。然而，系统性地刻画哪些基因与组织形态存在关联、这些关联是否具有空间变异性，以及哪些基因在形态所捕获的模式之外还表现出额外的空间表达模式，仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出 MorphoANOVA，一个以基因为单位的统计框架，用于刻画 ST 所测基因中形态—表达关系。MorphoANOVA 采用嵌套的空间变系数模型和序贯方差分析，评估全切片范围内与 H&E 衍生形态特征的关联、这些关联的位置特异性变化，以及在考虑所选特征之后的额外空间变异。所得统计量可用于基因优先级排序和通路富集分析，而空间成分图有助于单个基因的解释。模拟实验证明 MorphoANOVA 能够区分所建模的各成分并恢复其空间模式。应用于人类皮层和乳腺癌，识别出与不同形态—表达模式相关的生物学程序，并揭示与细胞组成的独特关系。在三名 HER2 阳性乳腺癌患者中，浸润性癌标志基因一致地表现出更强的位置特异性形态关联证据。因此，MorphoANOVA 提供了一个系统解释空间基因表达模式与组织形态关系的框架。

papers.title: Synthetic chromatin engineering for STAT1 reactivation toward restoring cisplatin sensitivity in breast cancer
papers.translated_title: 合成染色质工程用于STAT1再激活以恢复乳腺癌对顺铂的敏感性
papers.author: Park, I.-G.
papers.summary: Chemoresistant cancers acquire transcriptomic and epigenetic alterations through changes in transcription factor activity and chromatin accessibility. Integrative in silico analyses identified STAT1 as a recurrently suppressed transcription factor in cisplatin-resistant breast cancer. Using cisplatin-resistant triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) MDA-MB-231 cells, we further confirmed reduced STAT1 expression and activity, accompanied by defective nuclear translocation, indicating that suppression of STAT1 signaling contributes to cisplatin resistance in breast cancer. To restore STAT1 activity, we sought to promote its nuclear localization and transcriptional activation through chromatin engineering. Based on the identification of PHF6 as a direct STAT1-binding protein through in silico and in vitro analyses, we engineered Dual Reader 3 (DR3), a PHF6-derived synthetic chromatin regulator designed to enhance both STAT1 interaction and chromatin engagement through histone H2B ubiquitination. DR3 induced STAT1-associated transcriptional programs, including inflammatory and tumor-suppressive miRNAs. Mechanistically, DR3 physically promoted STAT1 nuclear translocation, activated STAT1 through a non-canonical S727-dependent mechanism independent of Tyr701 phosphorylation, and enhanced chromatin accessibility at STAT1-responsive regulatory regions through histone H2B ubiquitination. CUT&RUN analysis further revealed coordinated transcriptional and epigenetic remodeling associated with DR3-mediated STAT1 activation, including upregulation of HIPK2, which enhanced cellular sensitivity to cisplatin by strengthening the intrinsic DNA damage response. Finally, we investigated whether STAT1 reactivation could alleviate acquired cisplatin resistance. In vivo delivery of DR3 restored cisplatin sensitivity in resistant breast tumors. By coupling STAT1 nuclear translocation with chromatin remodeling, DR3 reactivated STAT1-dependent transcriptional programs and restored cisplatin sensitivity in breast cancer. Together, this study establishes transcription factor reactivation through synthetic chromatin engineering as a potential therapeutic strategy for overcoming chemoresistance in solid tumors.
papers.translated_summary: 化疗耐药癌症通过转录因子活性和染色质可及性的变化获得转录组和表观遗传改变。整合性计算机分析鉴定STAT1为顺铂耐药乳腺癌中反复受抑制的转录因子。利用顺铂耐药三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）MDA-MB-231细胞，我们进一步证实STAT1表达和活性降低，伴随核转位缺陷，表明STAT1信号抑制促进乳腺癌顺铂耐药。为恢复STAT1活性，我们试图通过染色质工程促进其核定位和转录激活。基于通过计算机和体外分析鉴定PHF6为直接STAT1结合蛋白，我们设计了Dual Reader 3（DR3），一种源自PHF6的合成染色质调节因子，旨在通过组蛋白H2B泛素化增强STAT1相互作用和染色质结合。DR3诱导STAT1相关转录程序，包括炎症和肿瘤抑制性miRNA。机制上，DR3物理促进STAT1核转位，通过不依赖Tyr701磷酸化的非经典S727依赖机制激活STAT1，并通过组蛋白H2B泛素化增强STAT1响应调控区域的染色质可及性。CUT&RUN分析进一步揭示与DR3介导的STAT1激活相关的协调转录和表观遗传重塑，包括HIPK2上调，其通过增强内在DNA损伤应答提高细胞对顺铂的敏感性。最后，我们研究STAT1再激活能否缓解获得性顺铂耐药。体内递送DR3恢复耐药乳腺肿瘤的顺铂敏感性。通过将STAT1核转位与染色质重塑耦合，DR3重新激活STAT1依赖转录程序并恢复乳腺癌顺铂敏感性。总之，本研究确立通过合成染色质工程实现转录因子再激活作为克服实体瘤化疗耐药的潜在治疗策略。

papers.title: Programmable interphyla communication for Staphylococcus aureus by transferability of homoserine lactone sensors between Bacillales bacteria
papers.translated_title: 金黄色葡萄球菌的可编程跨门通讯通过高丝氨酸内酯传感器在芽孢杆菌目细菌间的可转移性实现
papers.author: Sarker, B.
papers.summary: Staphylococcus aureus is a Gram-positive opportunistic pathogen of the order Bacillales and a frequent member of human-associated microbiomes. Despite its clinical relevance, engineering S. aureus and the communities it inhabits remains limited by a shortage of well-characterized genetic tools for precise control of gene expression and intercellular signaling. Biosensors for homoserine lactones (HSLs) are widely used in Gram-negative bacteria, as HSLs are small, passively diffusible signaling molecules for and their sensors are tightly regulated. Here, we show that synthetically designed HSL sensors using LuxR-family regulators are highly functional in S. aureus. Notably, synthetic designs previously built for the Gram-positive model Bacillus subtilis, a distantly related Bacillales, transferred functionally and establish repurposing the genetic toolbox as an effective strategy for importing these functions into S. aureus. Sensor performance correlated strongly between the two Bacillales, and activation in S. aureus reached 55-fold, exceeding the dynamic range of reported inducible systems. We further demonstrate tightly regulated, programmable interphyla communication between Gram-negative Escherichia coli and S. aureus via HSL signaling. These results provide a new toolset for engineering interbacterial communication and open a route to extending programmable HSL signaling to other tough-to-engineer bacteria.

papers.title: Early visual cortex is not functionally necessary for temporal attention: A TMS study
papers.translated_title: 早期视觉皮层对时间注意并非功能上必需：一项TMS研究
papers.author: Lee, H.-H.
papers.summary: Temporal attention enhances the selective processing of information at a specific point in time and improves perception. Previous neuroimaging studies investigating its neural mechanisms have either conflated temporal attention with temporal expectation or provided correlational evidence. Thus, whether early visual cortex is functionally necessary for temporal attention remains unknown. Here, we combined psychophysics with transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) to examine whether V1/V2 are functionally necessary and play a causal role in temporal attention. Observers performed an orientation-discrimination task in which two consecutive stimuli, T1 and T2, were presented in the periphery, preceded by a precue providing either valid or neutral temporal information. Double-pulse TMS was delivered under four conditions: at T1 (T1-TMS), at T2 (T2-TMS), at both T1 and T2 (both-TMS), or not at all (none-TMS), to assess its effects on temporal attention and the efficacy of the stimulation was verified by pupil size analysis. Behavioral results revealed robust temporal attention benefits on d', reaction time, and the Balanced Integration Score (BIS) across all four TMS conditions, indicating that the benefits of temporal attention were unaffected by occipital TMS. Furthermore, pupil dilation was largest in the both-TMS condition, followed by the T1-TMS and T2-TMS conditions, and smallest in the none-TMS condition, providing physiological verification of the stimulation protocol. Together, these findings reveal the first causal evidence that the early visual cortex is not functionally necessary for endogenous temporal attention.

papers.title: Novel Tau Interaction Partners as Potential Biomarkers and Therapeutic Targets in Neurodegenerative Diseases
papers.translated_title: 新型Tau相互作用伙伴作为神经退行性疾病潜在生物标志物和治疗靶点
papers.author: Pichlerova, K.
papers.summary: Alzheimers disease is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder leading to cognitive decline and ultimately death. One of the main hallmarks of this disease is the accumulation of pathological tau protein into neurofibrillary tangles. To better understand these pathological mechanisms, it is essential to characterize the tau protein interactome in health and disease. In this study, we performed a yeast two-hybrid screening using a human brain cDNA library, from which we identified 15 novel tau-interacting proteins that bind to full-length human tau, or its fragments: the N-terminus, microtubule-binding domain, or C-terminus. We subsequently validated these novel interactions using in vitro co-immunoprecipitation and colocalization assays with both physiological and pathological tau isoforms. Furthermore, their interactions with the human tau protein were analyzed using surface plasmon resonance. Finally, an in silico interactome analysis of these newly discovered tau-binding partners revealed several additional interactors that can link them to downstream processes critical to neurodegenerative pathways Our findings offer fresh insights into tau biology and highlight novel targets for therapeutic intervention and biomarker development.
papers.translated_summary: 阿尔茨海默病是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，导致认知功能下降并最终死亡。该疾病的主要标志之一是与病理相关的tau蛋白积累形成神经原纤维缠结。为了更好地理解这些病理机制，表征tau蛋白在健康和疾病状态下的相互作用组至关重要。在本研究中，我们使用人脑cDNA文库进行了酵母双杂交筛选，从中鉴定出15个新的tau相互作用蛋白，这些蛋白与全长人tau或其片段（N端、微管结合域或C端）结合。我们随后通过体外共免疫沉淀和共定位实验，使用生理性和病理性tau异构体验证了这些新发现的相互作用。此外，我们使用表面等离子体共振分析了它们与人tau蛋白的相互作用。最后，对这些新发现的tau结合伴侣进行的计算机相互作用组分析揭示了若干额外的相互作用因子，可将它们与对神经退行性通路至关重要的下游过程联系起来。我们的发现为tau生物学提供了新的见解，并突出了治疗干预和生物标志物开发的新靶点。

papers.title: Polyphyletic origins and lineage-specific expansion of chemosensory systems in phylum Actinomycetota
papers.translated_title: 放线菌门化学感受系统的多系起源与谱系特异性扩张
papers.author: S, S. N.
papers.summary: Phylum Actinomycetota (syn. Actinobacteriota or Actinobacteria), one of the largest well-studied bacterial phyla, is renowned for complex morphology, non-motility, ecological versatility, and secondary metabolite production. Chemosensory systems (CSS) are among the most sophisticated prokaryotic signal transduction architectures, yet their evolutionary distribution in this phylum remains poorly understood. Here, a comparative genomic analysis of 693 high-quality genomes spanning the phylum resolves the diversity, distribution, and evolutionary trajectories of CSS. Despite extensive genomic complexity and ecological versatility, only 6.9% of genomes encode complete CSS clusters, confined to a subset of lineages within a few classes, indicating lineage-specific retention or loss. In contrast, two-component systems (TCS) are ubiquitously abundant, with hybrid kinases enriched in CSS-deficient classes, suggesting functional compensation for the absence of dedicated chemosensory pathways. Basal lineages retain simplified CSS (F1 or F5), whereas Actinomycetes show lineage-specific expansion into multiple classes (F5, F8, F9, and ACF), often co-occurring, indicative of enhanced sensory complexity. The phylogeny of CheA homologs shows a polyphyletic distribution, supporting a mosaic evolutionary history shaped by multiple independent acquisitions, diversification, and gene loss. Collectively, our findings show that, unlike motile bacteria, members of Actinomycetota rely predominantly on TCS-driven regulatory networks, with CSS retained only in select lineages where ecological demands require enhanced environmental sensing. This work provides a phylum-wide evolutionary framework for the emergence, diversification, and functional specialization of CSS in non-motile bacteria.
papers.translated_summary: 放线菌门（Actinomycetota，同义名Actinobacteriota或Actinobacteria）是研究最为深入的大型细菌门之一，以其复杂的形态、非运动性、生态多功能性及次级代谢产物产生而著称。化学感觉系统（chemosensory systems, CSS）是最复杂的原核信号转导架构之一，但其在该门中的进化分布仍知之甚少。本文对覆盖该门的693个高质量基因组进行比较基因组分析，解析了CSS的多样性、分布及进化轨迹。尽管基因组复杂性和生态多功能性广泛存在，仅6.9%的基因组编码完整的CSS簇，且局限于少数纲内的部分谱系，表明存在谱系特异性保留或丢失。相比之下，双组分系统（two-component systems, TCS）普遍丰富，杂合激酶在CSS缺陷的纲中富集，提示其对专用化学感觉通路缺失的功能补偿。基部谱系保留简化的CSS（F1或F5），而放线菌纲则显示谱系特异性扩展为多个类别（F5、F8、F9和ACF），且常共现，表明感觉复杂性增强。CheA同源物的系统发育显示多系分布，支持由多次独立获得、多样化和基因丢失塑造的镶嵌式进化历史。总体而言，我们的发现表明，与运动性细菌不同，放线菌门成员主要依赖TCS驱动的调控网络，CSS仅保留在生态需求要求增强环境感知的选择性谱系中。本研究为非运动性细菌中CSS的出现、多样化和功能特化提供了门水平的进化框架。

papers.title: Hypoxic Stress Induces LARP1-Driven Stress Granules That Protect mRNAs from Decay to Sustain Mitotic Cell Cycle Progression
papers.translated_title: 缺氧应激诱导LARP1驱动的应激颗粒保护mRNA免于降解以维持有丝分裂细胞周期进程
papers.author: Lim, T.
papers.summary: Hypoxia is a defining feature of solid tumours that elicits extensive transcriptional and post-transcriptional adaptations. Stress granules (SGs) are frequently observed under hypoxia, yet how they assemble and whether they contribute to hypoxic gene regulation remain poorly understood. Here, we show that hypoxia induces SGs through an assembly mechanism distinct from that of classical acute stresses. Hypoxia SG formation occurs independently of the integrated stress response and instead requires the HIF1-REDD1-mTORCC1-4EBP1 axis. Remarkably, hypoxia SGs assemble despite robust ongoing translation, suggesting that additional mechanisms lower the threshold for RNA condensation. We identify LARP1 as a potential determinant of this process, where it promotes G3BP-dependent SG assembly specifically during hypoxia. Despite their distinct assembly mechanism, hypoxia and arsenite SGs recruit broadly similar RNA populations, with selective differences validated by single-molecule FISH, suggesting that conserved principles govern RNA partitioning across different SG states. Functionally, sequestration into hypoxia SGs correlates with enhance protein expression whereby a subset of mRNAs are protected from decay. Transcriptomic analyses further reveal that this protection sustains a broader gene-expression program enriched for MCM complex and mitotic cell-cycle regulators. Accordingly, disruption of hypoxia SGs reduces mitotic progression and proliferative competence during prolonged hypoxia. Together, our findings establish LARP1-mediated condensation as a mechanism that enables SG assembly despite ongoing translation and reveal that SG sequestration preserves selected mRNAs from decay to sustain the gene-expression programs required for long-term adaptation to hypoxia.
papers.translated_summary: 缺氧是实体肿瘤的一个决定性特征，可引发广泛的转录和转录后适应。应激颗粒（SGs）在缺氧条件下经常被观察到，但其如何组装以及是否参与缺氧基因调控仍知之甚少。在此，我们表明缺氧通过一种不同于经典急性应激的组装机制诱导SGs。缺氧SG的形成不依赖于整合应激反应，而是需要HIF1-REDD1-mTORCC1-4EBP1轴。值得注意的是，缺氧SGs在翻译持续旺盛进行的情况下仍能组装，提示存在额外机制降低RNA凝聚的阈值。我们鉴定LARP1为该过程的潜在决定因素，它特异性地在缺氧期间促进G3BP依赖的SG组装。尽管组装机制不同，缺氧和亚砷酸盐SGs招募的RNA群体大体相似，单分子FISH验证了选择性差异，提示保守原则支配着不同SG状态下的RNA分配。在功能上，隔离进入缺氧SGs与蛋白质表达增强相关，其中一部分mRNA受到保护免于降解。转录组分析进一步揭示，这种保护维持了一个更广泛的基因表达程序，富集于MCM复合体和有丝分裂细胞周期调控因子。相应地，破坏缺氧SGs会降低长期缺氧期间的有丝分裂进程和增殖能力。总之，我们的发现确立了LARP1介导的凝聚作为一种机制，使SG组装能够在翻译持续进行的情况下发生，并揭示SG隔离保护选定mRNA免于降解，以维持长期适应缺氧所需的基因表达程序。

papers.title: Single-cell profiling of human plaques reveals cellular and molecular signatures of symptomatic atherosclerosis
papers.translated_title: 人类斑块的单细胞图谱揭示症状性动脉粥样硬化的细胞与分子特征
papers.author: Ray, A.
papers.summary: Atherosclerotic plaque vulnerability drives ischemic cardiovascular events, yet the cellular and molecular signatures distinguishing symptomatic from asymptomatic human plaques remain poorly defined. Here, we compared 53 symptomatic and asymptomatic human carotid plaques using single-nucleus (snRNA-seq; 17 samples, 19,100 nuclei; AtherOMICS biobank) and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq; 36 samples, 68,983 cells; four public datasets), analyzed independently and combined by meta-analysis. Across sequencing approaches, symptomatic plaques showed cell-state shifts toward later or terminal states in osteochondrogenic smooth muscle cells (SMCs) and CD4 T cells, as well as transcriptional changes toward inflammatory and epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) in endothelial cells (ECs), T cells, and fibroblasts. Nuclear profiling uncovered a depletion of fibroblasts in symptomatic plaques, marked by downregulation of RGS5. Integrating these transcriptomic signatures with genome-wide association data for coronary, cerebrovascular, and peripheral atherosclerotic disease, we found that genetic risk was enriched primarily in vascular wall cells (SMCs, fibroblasts, ECs), rather than immune cell types. The analyses further nominated higher TWIST1 expression in ECs (colocalized with risk across four atherosclerotic phenotypes), lower GUCY1A1 expression in fibroblasts and macrophages, and higher MRAS expression in T cells as candidate driver mechanisms linking genetic risk to symptomatic plaque transition. These findings provide novel insights into cellular and molecular phenotypes associated with plaque vulnerability and identify potential driver mechanisms of symptomatic plaque transformation that could inform therapeutic development.
papers.translated_summary: 动脉粥样硬化斑块易损性驱动缺血性心血管事件，但区分有症状与无症状人类斑块的细胞和分子特征仍不明确。本研究比较了53例有症状与无症状人类颈动脉斑块，采用单核RNA测序（snRNA-seq；17例样本，19,100个细胞核；AtherOMICS生物样本库）和单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq；36例样本，68,983个细胞；四个公共数据集），分别独立分析并通过荟萃分析合并。跨测序方法一致显示，有症状斑块表现为骨软骨源性平滑肌细胞（SMCs）和CD4 T细胞向较晚或终末状态的细胞状态转变，以及内皮细胞（ECs）、T细胞和成纤维细胞向炎症和上皮-间质转化（EMT）方向的转录变化。细胞核图谱分析发现有症状斑块中成纤维细胞耗竭，以RGS5下调为标志。将这些转录组特征与冠状动脉、脑血管和外周动脉粥样硬化性疾病的全基因组关联数据整合，我们发现遗传风险主要富集于血管壁细胞（SMCs、成纤维细胞、ECs），而非免疫细胞类型。分析进一步提名ECs中较高的TWIST1表达（与四种动脉粥样硬化表型的风险共定位）、成纤维细胞和巨噬细胞中较低的GUCY1A1表达，以及T细胞中较高的MRAS表达，作为将遗传风险与有症状斑块转化联系起来的候选驱动机制。这些发现为与斑块易损性相关的细胞和分子表型提供了新的见解，并识别了可能有症状斑块转化的潜在驱动机制，可为治疗开发提供信息。

papers.title: Diagnostic Value in Discarded Reads: Re-evaluating Multi-Mapping cfDNA Fragmentomics and GC Bias in Early-Stage Cancer.
papers.translated_title: 废弃读段中的诊断价值：重新评估早期癌症中多比对cfDNA片段组学与GC偏倚
papers.author: UPPALURI, K. R.
papers.summary: Background. Low-coverage plasma cell-free DNA (cfDNA) sequencing is an inexpensive substrate for cancer detection. Standard pipelines discard fragments with low mapping quality, which originate mostly from repetitive DNA, although pericentromeric satellite repeats are frequently hypomethylated in cancer. We asked whether the fraction of multi-mapping cfDNA fragments differs between early-stage cancer and matched healthy controls, and how it compares with conventional fragmentomic features under strict control of technical factors. Methods. We analysed public plasma cfDNA whole-genome sequencing from 25 patients with stage I to III breast cancer and 25 healthy controls matched 1:1 for age, sex, smoking and alcohol use, each pair processed in the same library and sequencing batch, and from 8 early-stage hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) cases with 8 matched controls. For every sample we computed the fraction of autosomal fragments with MAPQ < 30 and the share of these fragments located in centromeric and heterochromatic cytobands, and related them to stage, grade and copy-number deviation as proxies of tumour burden. Classifiers were evaluated by leave-one-pair-out cross-validation in breast cancer and, trained on breast cancer only, applied unchanged to HCC. Robustness to GC content and sequencing depth was tested by within-fold residualisation and by fragment-level GC weighting. Conventional fragmentomic features (fragment length, end motifs, copy number, DELFI-like profiles and window features at transcription start sites) were evaluated under four GC-handling analyses. Results. The multi-mapping fraction was higher in breast cancer than in matched controls (median 5.38 % vs 5.19 %; higher in 19/25 pairs; paired p = 0.0006; cross-validated AUC 0.81, 95 % CI 0.67 - 0.94), in stage I (9/10 pairs), stage II (7/10) and stage III (3/5) disease and in every sequencing batch. The excess was concentrated in centromeric and heterochromatic bands, whose share of multi-mapping fragments rose from 22.0 % to 23.4 % (19/25 pairs; p = 0.004). Both signals persisted after within-fold adjustment for GC content and/or depth (AUC 0.64 - 0.76 for the multi-mapping fraction, 0.71 - 0.76 for the heterochromatic share) and under fragment-level GC weighting (18/25 pairs; p = 0.003). The multi-mapping difference was largest in stage I and decreased with stage (Spearman {rho} = -0.42, p = 0.04), and neither feature was associated with grade or copy-number deviation. In public tissue methylomes, satellites were hypomethylated in breast tumours to a similar extent as other late-replicating DNA, but the bin-level association between tumour hypomethylation and the cfDNA excess was weak and was explained by GC content. In HCC, the pre-specified endpoint, the breast-trained multi-mapping model, was not met (AUC 0.73; 5/8 pairs; sign test p = 0.36). In an exploratory analysis that was not pre-specified, the heterochromatic share was higher in 7/8 HCC pairs (p = 0.016; locked AUC 0.86, 95 % CI 0.62 - 1.00); across all 33 pairs, including the discovery pairs, it was higher in the cancer case in 26 (post hoc sign test p = 0.0007). In contrast, conventional fragmentomic features reached AUC 0.71 (breast) and 0.77 (HCC) only without fragment-level GC control; they tracked the per-sample coverage GC dependence and fell to chance under each of three GC-controlled analyses, including one that preserves promoter-specific signal. Conclusions. Multi-mapping cfDNA fragments, which are routinely discarded, differed between early-stage breast cancer and batch-matched controls, largely independently of GC content and sequencing depth, with an excess in centromeric and heterochromatic DNA. The signal did not scale with stage, its biological origin is unproven, and a read-quality contribution cannot be excluded from fragment files. It is a candidate marker that requires confirmation in larger cohorts with raw reads and tumour-fraction estimates.

papers.title: Statistical Analysis Plan for the REDEP study: Effectiveness of dual-mobility cups for preventing dislocation after primary total hip arthroplasty by a posterolateral approach compared to unipolar cups in elderly patients

papers.author: Hoonhout, O.
papers.summary: Periprosthetic hip dislocation is a frequent complication after primary total hip arthroplasty. Observational studies suggest that dual mobility cups may reduce dislocation risk to approximately 1%, but definitive randomized evidence supporting their routine use in primary total hip arthroplasty is absent. The REDEP trial is the first prospective, randomized controlled trial that compares dual mobility cups with unipolar cups in patients [≥]70 years who electively undergo primary total hip arthroplasty via a posterolateral approach. The primary objective of the trial is to determine the difference in the number of patients who suffer a periprosthetic dislocation of the hip within 1 year after primary total hip arthroplasty in this population. Other outcomes include the difference in the total number of hip dislocations (including recurrent dislocations within patients), differences in patient-reported outcome measures, and differences in the incidence of (serious) adverse events. This statistical analysis plan describes the primary statistical analysis for the REDEP study. The analyses described herein were defined prior to database lock and unblinding. Secondary analyses will be described in subsequent versions of this statistical analysis plan.

papers.title: Anorexia Nervosa Register-based Severity Trajectories: Polygenic and Comorbid Associations
papers.translated_title: 神经性厌食症基于登记数据的严重程度轨迹：多基因与共病关联
papers.author: Abdulkadir, M.
papers.summary: AbstractImportance. Anorexia nervosa (AN) is a severe psychiatric disorder with heterogeneous outcomes and elevated mortality. Characterizing severity trajectories may improve early risk stratification and targeted intervention. Objective. To identify AN severity trajectories using a register-based severity index (AN- RSI) and examine their associations with polygenic scores (PGS), preceding (prior to AN diagnosis) as well as subsequent (beyond 5 years post AN diagnosis) psychiatric and somatic disorders. Design. Population-based cohort study. Setting. Nationwide study in Denmark. Participants. Individuals born between 1963 and 2007 with diagnosed AN (N = 9534 individuals). Genetic data were available in a subsample (N = 5126). Exposures. Forty-one PGS indexing traits relevant to AN, and psychiatric and somatic disorders prior to AN diagnosis. Main Outcomes and Measures. AN-RSI trajectories, psychiatric, and somatic disorders beyond 5 years post AN diagnosis. Results. Three trajectories were identified: "low and stable" (32.6%), "medium and stable" (53.5%), and "high increasing" (14.0%). The "low and stable" group was used as the comparison group for all analyses. Each 1 standard deviation (SD) increase in AN PGS corresponded with 13% greater odds of following the "high increasing" trajectory. Increases in BMI and attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) PGS corresponded with 15% and 14% lower odds of following the "high increasing" trajectory, respectively. No preceding psychiatric or somatic disorders were significantly associated with trajectory membership. In contrast, subsequent psychiatric and somatic disorders were more likely in individuals following the "high increasing" trajectory with odds ratios ranging between 1.7 (ADHD) and 3.7 (psychoactive substance dependence) for psychiatric disorders and between 1.6 (poor fetal growth of child) and 4 (microcytic anemia) for somatic disorders. Conclusions and Relevance. Our findings demonstrate that individuals with AN follow distinct severity trajectories that are associated with differences in polygenic risk and post- diagnostic morbidity patterns but not with pre-diagnosis psychiatric or somatic morbidity. As the field progresses, incorporating PGS into comprehensive assessments at first presentation may aid in early identification, personalized intervention, and resource allocation for individuals at higher risk of developing a severe illness trajectory. Key pointsQuestion: Do patients with anorexia nervosa follow distinct severity trajectories that are associated with specific genetic and morbidity risks? Findings: In this register-based study we identified three severity trajectories of anorexia nervosa. Those who followed the most severe illness trajectory had greater genetic liability to lower body weight and anorexia nervosa and were at greater risk for developing subsequent psychiatric and somatic disorders. Meaning: Illness severity trajectories in anorexia nervosa marked by genetic risk may assist in early identification and intervention for those at greatest risk of severe illness.
papers.translated_summary: 摘要重要性。神经性厌食症（AN）是一种严重的精神疾病，其结局异质性强且死亡率升高。刻画严重程度轨迹可能有助于改善早期风险分层和针对性干预。目的。使用基于登记资料的严重程度指数（AN-RSI）识别AN严重程度轨迹，并检验其与多基因评分（PGS）、既往（AN诊断之前）以及后续（AN诊断后5年以上）精神疾病和躯体疾病的关联。设计。基于人群的队列研究。环境。丹麦全国性研究。参与者。1963年至2007年出生且被诊断为AN的个体（N = 9534名个体）。遗传数据可在子样本中获得（N = 5126）。暴露。41项PGS，索引与AN相关的特征，以及AN诊断之前的精神疾病和躯体疾病。主要结局与测量。AN-RSI轨迹、AN诊断后5年以上的精神疾病和躯体疾病。结果。识别出三种轨迹：“低且稳定”（32.6%）、“中等且稳定”（53.5%）和“高且上升”（14.0%）。“低且稳定”组作为所有分析的比较组。AN PGS每增加1个标准差（SD），对应遵循“高且上升”轨迹的几率增加13%。BMI和注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）PGS的增加分别对应遵循“高且上升”轨迹的几率降低15%和14%。没有任何既往精神疾病或躯体疾病与轨迹归属显著相关。相比之下，遵循“高且上升”轨迹的个体后续精神疾病和躯体疾病的可能性更高，精神疾病的比值比范围为1.7（ADHD）至3.7（精神活性物质依赖），躯体疾病的比值比范围为1.6（子代胎儿生长不良）至4（小细胞性贫血）。结论与意义。我们的研究结果表明，AN个体遵循不同的严重程度轨迹，这些轨迹与多基因风险和诊断后疾病模式差异相关，但与诊断前精神疾病或躯体疾病无关。随着该领域的发展，在首次就诊时将PGS纳入综合评估，可能有助于对处于更严重疾病轨迹较高风险的个体进行早期识别、个性化干预和资源分配。关键点问题：神经性厌食症患者是否遵循与特定遗传和疾病风险相关的不同严重程度轨迹？发现：在这项基于登记资料的研究中，我们识别出神经性厌食症的三种严重程度轨迹。遵循最严重疾病轨迹者具有更高的较低体重和神经性厌食症遗传易感性，并且发生后续精神疾病和躯体疾病的风险更高。意义：以遗传风险为标志的神经性厌食症疾病严重程度轨迹，可能有助于对严重疾病风险最高者进行早期识别和干预。

papers.title: CMR-Derived Myocardial Strain May Reflect Advanced Graft Injury Rather Than Acute Rejection After Heart Transplantation
papers.translated_title: CMR衍生的心肌应变可能反映心脏移植后的晚期移植物损伤而非急性排斥反应
papers.author: Taipale, M.
papers.summary: Aims Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR) T1 and T2 mapping accurately detect acute heart transplant rejection, but the diagnostic value of CMR-derived strain imaging remains uncertain, particularly for right ventricular strain. Data incorporating donor-derived cell-free DNA (dd-cfDNA) into a composite reference standard are limited. We evaluated the diagnostic accuracy of CMR-derived left and right ventricular strain and ejection fraction for detecting acute rejection in pediatric and adult heart transplant recipients. Methods and results Blinded analysis of 1.5T CMR studies was performed in pediatric and adult heart transplant recipients 1-24 months post-transplant and during five additional rejection episodes 3-14 years post-transplant. Left and right ventricular strain and ejection fraction were quantified using semi-automated post-processing. Acute rejection was defined using a composite reference standard comprising endomyocardial biopsy (EMB), clinical assessment, and dd-cfDNA. Diagnostic performance was assessed using cut-offs from receiver operator characteristic analysis. Among 214 CMR studies in 58 patients, 13 cases of acute rejection were identified. Diagnostic performance for detecting acute rejection was highest for pediatric right ventricular longitudinal strain (AUC 0.782, 95% CI 0.565-0.999), although imprecise due to data heterogeneity. All other cardiac functional parameters demonstrated limited discrimination in both pediatric and adult patients (AUC 0.536-0.739). Models based on individual rejection indicators (EMB, clinical assessment, and dd-cfDNA) also showed poor diagnostic accuracy. Conclusion CMR-derived strain and ejection fraction showed limited diagnostic value for detecting acute rejection. Routine strain analysis therefore appears to have limited utility for rejection surveillance, with abnormalities primarily reflecting more advanced graft injury.

papers.title: A Local Enrichment Computational Framework to Identify Disease-Enriched Physical Activity Patterns
papers.translated_title: 一个用于识别疾病富集身体活动模式的局部富集计算框架
papers.author: qian, h.
papers.summary: Wearable accelerometers enable continuous monitoring of physical activity (PA), yet conventional summary measures and population-wide clustering approaches may overlook disease-associated behavioral heterogeneity. Here we introduce LocPA, a computational framework that identifies disease-enriched PA patterns through confounder-adjusted activity profiling, similarity network construction, local disease-enrichment testing and community detection. Applying LocPA to 24-hour accelerometry profiles from the UK Biobank, we identified two recurring PA phenotypes across six diseases spanning cardiometabolic, neurological, psychiatric, renal and cardiovascular conditions: a low-activity phenotype characterized by reduced daytime activity and a sleep-disrupted phenotype characterized by reduced daytime and elevated nocturnal activity. In hypertension and diabetes, the sleep-disrupted phenotype was associated with greater disease burden and less favorable clinical and metabolic profiles, differences not consistently captured by conventional PA summary measures. LocPA also identified disease-specific temporal patterns, particularly in Parkinsons disease. Analyses in an independent National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey cohort supported the recurrence of hypertension- and diabetes-enriched patterns across populations and accelerometry measurements. LocPA provides a flexible, disease-driven approach for uncovering clinically relevant temporal PA patterns, with potential applications in disease risk characterization and personalized behavioral interventions.
papers.translated_summary: 可穿戴加速度计能够连续监测身体活动（PA），但传统的汇总指标和全人群聚类方法可能忽略与疾病相关的行为异质性。在此，我们提出LocPA，一个计算框架，通过混杂因素校正的活动谱分析、相似性网络构建、局部疾病富集检验和社区检测来识别疾病富集的PA模式。将LocPA应用于英国生物银行（UK Biobank）的24小时加速度计数据，我们在涵盖心血管代谢、神经、精神、肾脏和心血管疾病的六种疾病中识别出两种反复出现的PA表型：一种以日间活动减少为特征的低活动表型，以及一种以日间活动减少和夜间活动升高为特征的睡眠紊乱表型。在高血压和糖尿病中，睡眠紊乱表型与更大的疾病负担和较不利的临床及代谢特征相关，这些差异未被传统PA汇总指标一致捕捉。LocPA还识别出疾病特异性的时间模式，尤其是在帕金森病中。在一个独立的美国国家健康与营养调查（NHANES）队列中的分析支持高血压和糖尿病富集模式在不同人群和加速度计测量中的重现。LocPA提供了一种灵活的、以疾病为导向的方法来揭示具有临床相关性的时间PA模式，在疾病风险表征和个性化行为干预方面具有潜在应用。

papers.title: Increase in Surgical Case Mix Index Across a Multi-Hospital System with Structured Limited Surgeon Chart Review
papers.translated_title: 多医院系统中结构化有限外科医生病历审查后手术病例组合指数的提升
papers.author: Kamine, T. H.
papers.summary: IntroductionHospitals face increasing financial pressures. Hospital reimbursement is tied to the Case Mix Index (CMI). The CMI is a measure of complexity of care provided by the hospital and the total reimbursement is the CMI multiplied by a base pay factor, multiplied by the total number of discharges from the hospital. The few studies in the literature have involved logistically complex attempts to improve documentation. We sought to determine whether limited, structured chart review by surgeons can improve CMI in a multihospital system. MethodsWe performed a prospective, observational study in a four-hospital academic medical system on all surgical patients from 10/2022 to 7/2026. Two clinically busy trauma surgeons performed limited structured chart reviews for select surgical patients. In the limited intervention period (1/2024-9/2024) this focused only on the trauma division. In the full intervention period (10/2024-7/2026) expanded to all surgical patients across the system. The main outcome was surgical case mix index (CMI). ResultsA total of 35,695 patients were included (13,811 pre-intervention, 9,337 limited intervention, 12,547 full intervention). CMI increased significantly among surgical patients across the whole system (2.68 (95%CI 2.65-2.71) to 2.87 (95%CI 2.82-2.92) to 2.97 (95%CI 2.93-3.01), ANOVA p <0.001). Overall length of stay was unchanged among surgical patients across the whole system. The estimated increase in revenue per patient attributable to this intervention was $3,912 in surgical patients across the system. ConclusionHaving trauma surgeons review targeted surgical patients for high value documentation capture significantly enhanced the CMI and estimated revenue of surgical services across a multi-hospital integrated health system. Such documentation reviews may represent a practical method to improve hospital documentation and revenue. Level of EvidenceLevel IV Study TypeProspective cohort study with historical controls Key MessagesWhat is already known on this topic: Documentation is critically important for hospital billing. Previous studies in trauma and acute care surgery have shown that large, intensive, and dedicated interventions can improve documentation and improve revenue generation. What this study adds: By creating a list of Major Comorbidity/Complication (MCC) and Comorbidity/Complication (CC) codes for targeted review, two clinically busy trauma surgeons were able to perform limited, targeted chart review with significant improvement in DRG capture and Case Mix Index. How this study might affect research, practice or policy: Improvements in documentation are facilitated by the targeted list of MCC and CC codes that other centers can use to improve their DRG capture, further demonstrating the financial benefit of a trauma and acute care surgery service.

papers.title: Self-harm incidents and restrictive practice use in an acute female inpatient unit: a service evaluation of a continuous multi-system improvement approach
papers.translated_title: 急性女性住院病房中的自伤事件与限制性措施使用：一种持续多系统改进方法的服务评估
papers.author: Johnson, S.
papers.summary: Background: Self-harm is a frequent and challenging occurrence in adult inpatient psychiatric units. The use of restrictive practice to manage self-harm incidents continues to be widespread within mental health environments despite increasing national and organisational guidance to minimise its use. Aim: The aim of this project was to introduce and evaluate a continuous quality improvement programme to progressively reduce incidents of self-harm and the use of restrictive practice. The project was set in a female acute mental health inpatient unit. The project sought to embed improvements in an inpatient unit interventions, procedures, and culture and staff mindset, and move towards a sustained collaborative and positive therapeutic and communication-based approach. Methods: A retrospective service evaluation design was employed to assess differences in the number of incidents of self-harm, enhanced observation, seclusion, restraint and rapid tranquillisation in the period following the introduction of a continuous whole-systems multimodal interventional initiative in 2019. Pre- and post-initiation data were compared (2017/18 compared to 2019/2025) to evaluate improvement and whether this had been sustained. Data were analysed using descriptive statistics, including frequencies, percentages, and means. Results: Self-harm incidents reduced between 2017/18 and 2019, with a downward trend sustained between 2019 and 2025 (136 to 72 incidents respectively between 2019 and 2025; 47% reduction). A sustained reduction in the use of restrictive practice was shown in all domains pre- and post-initiation (2017/18 compared to 2025). Clinical implications: No one approach will successfully reduce self-harm and the use of restrictive practice. Approaches employed have to be multi-faceted, multi-interdisciplinary, collaborative, and blend together to deliver improvement. Sustained progress requires commitment to an iterative process of continuous collaboration, improvement and adaptation.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：自伤是成人精神科住院病房中常见且具有挑战性的事件。尽管国家和组织层面越来越多地发布指导以减少限制性措施的使用，但在精神卫生环境中，使用限制性措施来管理自伤事件的做法仍然普遍存在。目的：本项目旨在引入并评估一项持续质量改进方案，以逐步减少自伤事件的发生和限制性措施的使用。项目设置于一个女性急性精神卫生住院病房。项目力求将改进融入住院病房的干预措施、流程、文化及员工思维方式中，并朝着持续的、协作性的、以积极治疗和沟通为基础的方法迈进。方法：采用回顾性服务评估设计，评估在2019年引入持续性全系统多模式干预方案后，自伤事件、强化观察、隔离、约束和快速镇静的发生数量差异。比较启动前后的数据（2017/18年度与2019/2025年度），以评估改进情况及其是否得以持续。数据采用描述性统计进行分析，包括频数、百分比和均值。结果：自伤事件在2017/18年度至2019年间有所减少，且2019年至2025年间保持下降趋势（2019年至2025年间分别为136起和72起事件；减少47%）。在启动前后（2017/18年度与2025年度相比），限制性措施的使用在所有领域均显示出持续减少。临床意义：没有任何单一方法能够成功减少自伤和限制性措施的使用。所采用的方法必须是多方面的、多学科交叉的、协作性的，并相互融合以实现改进。持续进展需要对持续协作、改进和适应的迭代过程作出承诺。

papers.title: Negotiating the Social Self in Chronic Spinal Pain: A Qualitative Study
papers.translated_title: 慢性脊柱疼痛中社会自我的协商：一项定性研究
papers.author: Sonjon, Y.
papers.summary: Purpose: This study examined how people living with chronic spinal pain experience, interpret and navigate social representations of their condition and the interactions these generate across clinical, occupational, and personal settings. Materials and Methods: Thirty semi-structured interviews were analysed using an approach informed by constructivist grounded theory, through initial, focused and theoretical coding. Results: Five categories emerged, capturing how social representations and relational dynamics threatened the social self and prompted deliberate strategies for restoring agency. Theoretical coding identified a central process (maintaining and rebuilding the social self), describing how participants navigated these threats across social contexts. Notably, approximately half the participants reproduced, without revision, representations of chronic pain typical of the general population, directing judgements of simulation or inadequate effort at others with the condition. These strategies primarily aimed to restore agency and maintain a viable social self, rather than to reduce pain. Conclusions: These findings describe one process through which social environments shape the experience of chronic spinal pain by influencing how the social self is continually negotiated. Recognising these processes may help rehabilitation professionals attend to the social dimensions of chronic pain.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：本研究考察慢性脊柱疼痛患者如何体验、解读和应对其病症的社会表征，以及这些表征在临床、职业和个人环境中引发的互动。材料与方法：采用受建构主义扎根理论启发的方法，通过初始编码、聚焦编码和理论编码，对三十份半结构化访谈进行分析。结果：涌现出五个类别，揭示了社会表征和关系动态如何威胁社会自我，并促使患者采取策略以恢复能动性。理论编码识别出一个核心过程（维持和重建社会自我），描述了参与者如何在各种社会情境中应对这些威胁。值得注意的是，约半数参与者未经修正地再现了普通人群对慢性疼痛的典型表征，将模拟或努力不足的判断指向其他患有该病症的人。这些策略主要旨在恢复能动性和维持可存续的社会自我，而非减轻疼痛。结论：这些发现描述了一个过程，即社会环境通过影响社会自我如何被持续协商，从而塑造慢性脊柱疼痛的体验。认识这些过程可能有助于康复专业人员关注慢性疼痛的社会维度。

papers.title: A Framework for Variant Filtering to Improve Diagnostic Outcomes in Genome Sequencing
papers.translated_title: 用于改善基因组测序诊断结果的变异过滤框架
papers.author: Birnbaum, R.
papers.summary: Rare genetic disorders frequently remain undiagnosed despite the use of exome sequencing (ES) and genome sequencing (GS). This study aimed to enhance diagnostic yield by introducing a systematic framework: SMART filtering (Systematic, Multi-step, Automated, Rare variant prioritization Tool), designed to optimize GS analysis, with a particular emphasis on non-coding regions. We retrospectively analyzed 153 cases with previously negative ES and GS results. SMART filtering was applied as a pre-annotation filtering step, integrating conservation metrics, allele frequency thresholds, and splicing prediction scores. Then followed by phenotype-based prioritization and manual review. Application of this framework identified pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants in 4.6% of cases, strong variants of uncertain significance (VUS) in 1.3%, and additional candidate variants in 5.2% of cases. Several deep-intronic variants were confirmed by RNA studies and segregation analyses. The framework enabled efficient prioritization of non-coding and regulatory variants that were overlooked by standard analyses. In conclusion, SMART filtering offers a reproducible and scalable strategy to improve diagnostic yield in GS, particularly in cases where conventional analysis methods fall short. Integrating such frameworks into clinical genomic pipelines can enhance variant interpretability and diagnostic performance, ultimately leading to better patient care outcomes.
